snippet.title: City of Dolorosa - English Trailer
snippet.description:
You've just died, and your trial for the ultimate sin begins. 
City of Dolorosa is an interactive fiction and first-person exploration game with handmade india ink graphics. 
Meet the Five Great Powers and uncover all the secrets that lie within Dolorosa, the cruelest city in Hell.

We are Cuelebre Cult, making games from the north of Spain 🐍

Add Dolorosa to your steam wishlist! 👺
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3246880/City_of_Dolorosa/
